title: The Effect of Home-Sharing on House Prices and Rents: Evidence from Airbnb
authors: Kyle Barron; Edward Kung; Davide Proserpio
eligible_reason: Continuous treatment with a shift-share instrument. The regressor is log Airbnb listings in the zipcode (airbnb) and its interaction with the 2010 owner-occupancy rate, instrumented with Google-Trends-for-Airbnb x 2010 zipcode touristiness (instr*): reghdfe lnrent/lnprice [lnpop lnmedinc bashare emprate] (airbnb airbnbXoorate10 = instr*), a(zipcode cbsa_date) cluster(zipcode). OLS columns use the same continuous regressor. The shipped manuscript (main.tex) describes the first stage as 'analogous to a difference-in-differences' and checks pre-trends by touristiness quartile graphically, but no binary staggered treatment is estimated.
design_notes: Stata (+ MATLAB Monte Carlo, R plots). forpublication/replication/code/myregs_loglog.do (main OLS/IV tables for rent, price, price-to-rent), iv_validity_loglog.do, myregs_supply.do, robustness do-files (tourism controls, Google Trends competitors, subsamples by time/size/distance/vacancy). Data: replication/data/replication_main.dta (zipcode-month panel).
screener_notes: Package includes the LaTeX manuscript and compiled PDF (paper.pdf, main.tex, apx.tex), which were grepped to confirm no binary DiD. Project-member paper (Proserpio). Not eligible: continuous treatment and IV.
